decisions.reason: Naval vessel lighting suits the firm's robust specialist niche and benefits from rising defence procurement, and the large firm's slack lets it carry the line through long procurement cycles, even though the dropping of the marine searchlights signals some pruning of the marine range.
The spring-balanced desk lamp keeps its own page and fits the ergonomic workplace portfolio, and with no evident shortfall against aspirations there is no trigger for problemistic search.
As a second-generation core interior luminaire, it represents a refresh of the established business that the firm is actively promoting.
The microprismatic pendant is presented as a flagship of the firm's direction toward efficient, human-centric lighting, so strategic commitment makes withdrawal unlikely.
